title: 2.1.36 Predict the Chain
description: Predict the output of an else if chain and a chained ternary before running them. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: designed — practice for tracing a chain, book Problem Set 2.1.7 intent (predict the value of a chained conditional)

steps.title: Predict, then run the else if chain
steps.instructions: Before running, write a comment above the chain guessing which branch will fire. Then run it and check your prediction.

steps.title: Predict, then run the chained ternary
steps.instructions: Write a second chain — this time with ? operators instead of else if — using different cutoff values than the first chain. Predict the result in a comment first, then run it.

requirements.title: else if chain present
requirements.description: Code contains an else if chain

requirements.title: chained ternary present
requirements.description: Code contains a chained ternary (two or more ? operators)
